buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Generic 1. The Seller shall not assign the Contract in whole or part without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 2. The Seller shall not sub-contract the Contract in whole or part to any entity without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 3. The Seller shall, notwithstanding the consent and assignment/sub-contract, remain jointly and severally liable and responsible to buyer together with the assignee/ sub-contractor, for and in respect of the due performance of the Contract and the Sellers obligations there under. 3. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid.

4. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 5. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 6. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 7. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 8. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 9. Purchase Preference (State) Bid reserved for MSE from the State of Bid Inviting Authority: Procurement under this bid is reserved for purchase from Micro and Small Enterprises from the State of Bid Inviting Authority having valid Udyam Registration and whose credentials are validated online through Udyam Registration portal. If the bidder wants to avail themselves of the reservation benefit, the bidder must be the manufacturer / OEM of the offered product on GeM. Traders are excluded from the purview of Public Procurement Policy for Micro and Small Enterprises and hence resellers offering products manufactured by some other OEM are not eligible to participate in this bid. In respect of bid for Services, the bidder must be the Service provider of the offered Service. Relevant documentary evidence in this regard shall be uploaded along with the bid in respect of the offered product or service, and Buyer will decide eligibility based on documentary evidence submitted, while evaluating the bid. Benefits of MSE will be allowed only if seller is validated on-line in GeM profile as well as validated and approved by Buyer after evaluation of documents submitted. 10. Past Project Experience Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a. Contract copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bidder that service/supplies against the invoices have been executed.b. Execution certificate by client with contract value.c. Any other document in support of contract execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc.Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a. Contract copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bidder that service/supplies against the invoices have been executed.b. Execution certificate by client with contract value.c. Any other document in support of contract execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc. 11. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Service and Support: A registered office of the service provider must be lo cated in the state of the consignee and the possession of PSARA license in the s tate of Andhra Pradesh is mandatory. Documentary evidence regarding the sa

me should be submitted. 2. Service provider shall ensure that the invoice is raised in the name of INC OME TAX OFFICER, WARD-1, ELURU. While generating invoice on GeM portal, th e seller must upload scanned copy screenshot of confirmation of GST payment. 3. Payment of salaries and wages: Service provider is required to pay salarie s/wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location from their own resources first and then claim payment from Buyer organization along with copy of payme nt of statutory documents like PF, ESI etc as well as bank statement of payment done to the contracted staff.Payment of wages by Service Provider to outsource d persons shall not be condition precedent or linked with payment of bills by Pur chaser or Income Tax department. Bidder will have to give an undertaking in thi s regard stating his ability to pay from own resources before receiving payment of bill from Purchaser. 4. The bidder should not be in liquidation, court receivership or similar proce edings, should not be bankrupt. Bidders should upload undertaking to this effec t with the bid. 5. Bidders are advised to check the applicable GST before quoting. 6. Bidders offer is liable to be rejected if they do not upload any of the certifi cates/Test reports sought in the bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 7. The bidders should have experience of at least 3 years in similar nature o f work. The bidder agencies should not be black listed by any Government or Se mi Government or any other organization. 8. The Service Provider /bidder should have valid GST registration, PF, ESI, C ST/VAT/TIN, TAN, trade tax registration, labour department registration and PA N. Necessary documents in this regard must be uploaded. 9. Preference shall be given to the person(s) who have past experience of w orking in any office of the Income Tax Department. Next preference shall be giv en to person(s) who have past experience of working in any other office of the C entral Government or the State Government. Decision of the Purchaser shall be final in this matter. . 12. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) Two Security Personnel shall be required to guard the entire office building at D r.No.23B-4-6/4, 2nd Floor, KKS Towers, R.R.Pet, Eluru and another two Security P ersonnel shall be required to guard the entire office building at Dr.No.24A-12-6/ 2, Aayakar Bhavan, Ashoknagar, Eluru round the clock on all days and on 24x7 basis in shifts(Day and Night). Thus, all the Security Guards shall be required to

work as Night Watchman also when their turn comes in roster. They will be resp onsible for guarding assets and property inside the office building and Quarters buildings as well as the open courtyard in front and back of the building. Howev er, no Security Guard shall leave place of duty before arrival of Security Guard o f next shift. In other words, at no time the place of duty of Security Guard cum Night Watchman shall lie deserted and empty. Security personnel should maint ain strict security of the officers/officials, material and premises. They will be re sponsible for thefts of easily movable items like official records, furniture items, computers, bathroom fittings, fans, telephone instruments etc. Alert the staff o n duty in case of fire and assist in fire fighting operations if necessary. Security personnel should conduct themselves in a fit manner before distinguished visito rs, VIPs and Officers of the Department. Security personnel shall maintain regist er for incoming/outgoing persons into the office premises. 13. Buyer Added Bid Specific SLA Text Clause(s) The service Provider on its part and through its resources shall ensure that 1. No Unauthorized Person(s) gain entry in the office premises and observe r egulations for entry/exit from the office gate No theft or pilferage takes place in any of the property of the office building. 2. To take all necessary steps to safe guard and protect the property of the Department and take in the interest maintaining proper security of office with d ue care and diligence. 3. To give such reports relating to Security matters at such frequency as ma y be demanded by the Department. 4. To provide complete security round the clock by changing the duty hours of the personnel in rotation of replacement subject to statutory Limitations. 5. The Service Provider shall be responsible for all acts of Commission and o mission on the part of its security Staff and will take Such preventive measure a nd precautions as may be deemed necessary for the Safety of the property / ma terial List contained in the office premises. 6. The service Provider will be Wholly and exclusively responsible for payme nt of wages to the persons engaged by it and compliance of all statutory obligations on its respect of all payments of wages Act, 1936, Minimum Wages Act, 1948, Employees Provident funds and Miscellaneous provisions Act, 1952, ESI Act, 1948, Workmen’s Compensation Act, 1923, and all other related Legisl ation as applicable and Department shall not incur any liability or additional exp enditure whatsoever for the persons employer by the service provider on accou nt of the above mentioned obligations.

7. All Security Personnel should be provided by the Service Provider With pr oper uniform, including headgear, boots, shoes, Whistle, lathies and other mate rial required for the smart turn out and efficient performance of the duties. 8. The service Provider shall ensure that the persons deputed by are medica lly fit. 9. It is clearly understood that the persons employed by the Service Provider shall not be deemed to the employees of the Department and shall have no rela tionship of Employer/ Employees or Master / Servant with the Department. 10. The Department shall not be Liable to any claim for damages or compens ation that might become payable to the employees of Service Provider in the ev ent of an accident resulting in any possible injury or death of any employee of th e service provider while performing their duty within/outside the premises referr ed to above or damage of any other kind. The Service Provider shall always kee p the Department fully indemnified against any such claim or damage. 11. The persons deputed by the service Provider shall not interfere with the duties of the employees of the department. 12. The service provider should replace the security personnel within 48 hour s as and when the Department makes any oral/written complaint about any of t he named persons. 13. The Service Provider should pay the minimum rates of wages to the secur ity personnel supplied to the Department and should disburse salaries/wages of contracted staff deployed at office location from their own sources first and the n claim payment from the department along with statutory documents like PF, E SI etc as well as bank statement of payment done to the contracted staff. 14. The Security personnel deployed by the service provider to serve the dep artment as per the agreement shall while on duty take the necessary instruction s from the authorized person by the service provider. 15. The service provider is responsible for the recovery of the property lost b y the department or it shall reimburse full amount of loss of pilferage caused dir ectly or indirectly without connivance of the security personnel. 16. If department suffers any loss or damage on account of negligence, defau

lt or theft on part of any of the employees/agents of the service provider, then t he service provider shall keep the department fully indemnified against against such loss or damage. 17. The service provider shall observe all laws, rules, regulations, orders and directions issued by the concerning for discharge of duties. Any contravention of such laws, rules, regulations, order and directions will be deemed to be breac h of contract and the service provider shall be liable for all such consequence a nd is case of any such breach, if the department incurs any obligations then the service provider shall be responsible to reimburse the department any loss mon etary or otherwise occasioned on account of such breach or contravention. 18. The service provider shall ensure and guarantee the behaviour and hones ty of the personnel deputed by it. In case of any misconduct or any other dama ge or theft to the property of the department the service provider shall be respo nsible for such losses or damages. The personnel of the service provider shall b e liable to be searched at the gate. 19. The service provider shall not assign, transfer, charge, hypothecate or in any manner make over the contract to any other agency without the consent of the department in writing. 20. The Service provider shall not disclose any information concerning the aff airs of the department which may have come to its knowledge without the cons ent of the department in writing. The service provider and personnel deputed b y it must sign appropriate confidentiality agreement/Non-disclosure agreement to protect confidential and sensitive information of the department. 21. The Service provider will submit its bills/invoices through GeM portal ever y month and the same will be paid following due procedure in GeM having fulfill ed satisfaction of the department its obligation under the contract. The departm ent however reserves the right to make such deductions out of its expenses inc urred by the department on behalf of the service provider for non performance of its part of the contract. 22. The contract will commence from the date of issuing such contract t o the service provider upto 03.12.2027. However, the contract can be term inated by either party on giving one month notice in advance. 23. If service provider commits breach of any conditions of contract or fails to fulfill its obligations, the department shall be at liberty to terminate the contract without any notice.

24. The Contract shall be valid from the date of signing of such agreement an d shall continue to be in force in the same manner unless terminated or modifie d in writing. The contract/agreement is renewable subject to the satisfactory pe rformance of the service provider and with such amendments/modified of terms and conditions as may be mutually agreed to including rise in wages/service ch arges taking into account the increase in minimum wages by the Government o f India after the contract comes in force. 25. On the expiry of contract as mentioned the service provider will withdraw all its personnel and clear their accounts by paying them all their legal dues as required under the provision of industrial disputes Act,1947 or any other laws a s applicable. 26. In case of any disputes on account of the termination of employment or n on employment by the personnel of the service provider it shall be the entire re sponsible of the service provider to pay and settle the same. 27. The service provider shall comply with all the order/awards passed by the competent authority/court in respect of the personnel engaged by it. Both bidde r and buyer can add to or delete any of the terms and conditions with mutual co nsent. 28. In event of any dispute raising in respect of the clause(s) of the contract t he matter will be referred to the Income Tax Officer,Ward-1, Eluru whose decisio n shall be binding on Service provider as well as Buyer Organization.
